summary: Неделя 1 пройдена! Тест: чтение и аудирование — C1. Понимаете вы отлично; дальше — строить фразы самой: вопросы, am/is/are, времена. Это и есть pack-003.

verdicts.correct: She is making great progress with her English.
verdicts.comment: «делать успехи» = make progress (не do success); сейчас → is making
Так тоже правильно: laugh at = смеяться над. make fun of = дразнить, высмеивать.

verdicts.correct: The printer has run out of paper.
verdicts.comment: run out OF + что закончилось; подлежащее — принтер; paper (бумага)

verdicts.correct: She made a phone call to the client.
verdicts.comment: make a call — верно! Артикль a: a (phone) call

verdicts.correct: He wishes he had taken the job.
verdicts.comment: О прошлом → had + 3-я форма; «согласиться на работу» = take / accept the job

verdicts.correct: She wasn't used to getting so much feedback.
verdicts.comment: «не привыкла» = wasn't used to + -ing; didn't use to = «раньше не…»

verdicts.correct: Thanks, that's really helpful.
verdicts.comment: useful — прилагательное (usefully — наречие)

verdicts.correct: It could take a lot of time to build.
verdicts.comment: could + глагол без be: could take. That would take too long — вариант эталона
Так тоже правильно.

verdicts.correct: One project I'm proud of is a redesign of an online store.
verdicts.comment: Пропущен am: I'm proud of. Артикли — верно!
Так тоже правильно: Do you have time for a short call tomorrow?

verdicts.correct: Feel free to stop me at any point.
verdicts.comment: at any moment / at any point (не in)

verdicts.correct: This part feels a bit crowded.
verdicts.comment: a bit / a little — перед прилагательным (второй раз)

verdicts.correct: I have a few open questions.
verdicts.comment: a few = несколько; few = мало (третий раз)

verdicts.correct: What does a typical day look like?
verdicts.comment: Вопрос: What + does + подлежащее + глагол. «как выглядит» = what … look like
Так тоже правильно.

verdicts.correct: I like how clear the navigation is.
verdicts.comment: «нравится, насколько понятная» = I like how clear… / I like that the navigation is clear

verdicts.correct: Maybe we could simplify this step.
verdicts.comment: Probably = вероятно; «может быть» в предложении = maybe. This step could be simpler — тоже можно

verdicts.correct: If you tap here, a bottom sheet opens.
verdicts.comment: Нужно подлежащее: If you tap; tap (нажать), tape — лента; bottom sheet

verdicts.correct: The main goal here is to reduce drop-offs.
verdicts.comment: отток = drop-offs / churn

verdicts.correct: This habit is deeply ingrained.
verdicts.comment: Пропущен is: is ingrained (как прилагательное)

verdicts.correct: After a while, it happens effortlessly.
verdicts.comment: effortlessly — наречие при глаголе: it happens effortlessly (или it becomes effortless)

verdicts.correct: You need to practise consistently.
verdicts.comment: consequently = следовательно; consistently = последовательно, регулярно

verdicts.correct: Link the new habit to a daily cue.
verdicts.comment: привязать к = link to / tie to; сигнал = cue

verdicts.correct: There is no one-size-fits-all approach.
verdicts.comment: «не существует» = there is no…; универсальный = one-size-fits-all / universal

verdicts.correct: My progress has plateaued.
verdicts.comment: plateau — здесь глагол: has plateaued (вышел на плато)
Очень полезный и честный текст: что легко, что трудно и почему. Мысль «запоминаю, когда вижу логику» — важная, учту её в новом пакете.

fixes.from: It was easy to did exercise in day of current rule
fixes.to: It was easy to do the exercises on the day of a new rule
fixes.why: после to — начальная форма: to do; on the day

fixes.from: after a few days, where I need to repeat
fixes.to: a few days later, when I needed to review

fixes.from: I have problems with remembering words or tools of if I don't see logic in them
fixes.to: I find it hard to remember words if I don't see the logic behind them
fixes.why: find it hard to + глагол; the logic behind them

fixes.from: I understand texts and audios well, but not clear, their context helps me
fixes.to: I understand texts and audio well — not word for word, but the context helps me
fixes.why: audio — без -s; «не дословно» = not word for word

fixes.from: I don't what what I have to repeat
fixes.to: I don't know what I need to review

fixes.from: I want to build correctly structure of sentences automatically
fixes.to: I want to build sentences correctly and automatically

verdicts.comment: Живой и связный текст по теме статьи, слова ingrained и cues употреблены к месту. Ошибки — в формах и предлогах.

fixes.from: a lot of difference healthy and useful habits
fixes.to: a lot of different healthy and useful habits

fixes.from: do procedures for my face skin every time
fixes.to: follow my skincare routine every day

fixes.from: I think I am well done with this app
fixes.to: I think I'm doing well with this app
fixes.why: well done = «молодец!» (похвала); «у меня хорошо получается» = I'm doing well

fixes.from: when I'm waiting my child or when I'm laying with her
fixes.to: when I'm waiting for my child or lying down with her
fixes.why: wait FOR; lie (лежать) → lying; lay = класть

fixes.from: I have an interest to read ai analysis
fixes.to: I'm interested in reading the AI analysis
